WITH cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.ended_at,
        CAST(s.ended_at AS DATE) AS ended_date
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE LOWER(s.status) = 'cancelled'
),
customer_window AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        MIN(CAST(s.started_at AS DATE)) AS first_started_date
    FROM dim_customers c
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
active_base AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cw.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM customer_window cw
    WHERE cw.first_started_date IS NOT NULL
),
churn_events AS (
    -- Pessimistic: count every cancelled row, even if the same customer

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
current_q AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start AND c.churned_at < q.current_q_end) AS churned,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.signup_date < q.current_q_start AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start)) AS active_at_start
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
prev_q AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start AND c.churned_at < q.prev_q_end) AS churned,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.signup_date < q.prev_q_start AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start)) AS active_at_start
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
  'current_quarter' AS period,
  CAST(current_q.churned AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(current_q.active_at_start, 0) AS churn_rate,
  current_q.churned AS churned_customers,
  current_q.active_at_start AS customers_at_period_start
FROM current_q
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'previous_quarter' AS period,
  CAST(prev_q.churned AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(prev_q.active_at_start, 0) AS churn_rate,
  prev_q.churned AS churned_customers,
  prev_q.active_at_start AS customers_at_period_start
FROM prev_q;

  SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.status IN ('active','cancelled','paused')
),
arr_at_start AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
arr_today AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_jan1_2026,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_today) AS arr_current,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_today) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_ytd_growth

WITH start_mrr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
end_mrr AS (
  -- Retained MRR: for each cohort sub active at start of Q1, take min(its MRR, MRR of same customer active at end of Q1)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(retained), 0) AS mrr_retained
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.customer_id,
      s.mrr AS start_mrr_val,
      LEAST(
        s.mrr,
        COALESCE((
          SELECT SUM(s2.mrr)
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.mrr > 0
            AND s2.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
            AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
        ), 0)
      ) AS retained
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = false
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
  ) t
)
SELECT
  start_mrr.mrr_start,
  end_mrr.mrr_retained,
  CASE WHEN start_mrr.mrr_start > 0 THEN end_mrr.mrr_retained / start_mrr.mrr_start END AS gross_retention
FROM start_mrr, end_mrr;

  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE

    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
fy_revenue AS (
  SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.amount) AS revenue_2025

  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
churn AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND c.churned_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS churn_rate_2025
  FROM active_customers a
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
),
arpu AS (
  SELECT AVG(COALESCE(r.revenue_2025, 0)) AS arpu_2025

)
SELECT

  0.75 AS gross_margin,
  (arpu.arpu_2025 * 0.75) / NULLIF(churn.churn_rate_2025, 0) AS ltv_fy2025
FROM arpu, churn;

WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE "timestamp" END AS ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value') AS DOUBLE),
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')  AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS deal_value,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
open_pipeline AS (
  -- opps created before Q2 FY2026 start (2026-04-01) and not closed before that date
  SELECT opp_id, MAX(deal_value) AS deal_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    AND event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND opp_id NOT IN (
      SELECT opp_id FROM normalized
      WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
        AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
        AND opp_id IS NOT NULL
    )
  GROUP BY opp_id
),
bookings AS (
  -- Q2 FY2026 closed-won bookings (Apr-Jun 2026) as the target denominator proxy
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS won_amount
  FROM normalized
  WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(deal_value) FROM open_pipeline) AS open_pipeline_entering_q2_fy2026,
  (SELECT won_amount FROM bookings) AS q2_fy2026_closed_won,
  (SELECT SUM(deal_value) FROM open_pipeline) / NULLIF((SELECT won_amount FROM bookings), 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio;

WITH recent_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at))) AS q_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    q_start,
    q_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS q_end
  FROM recent_quarter
),
active_at_start AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s, bounds b
  WHERE s.started_at < b.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.q_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')
    AND s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customers WHERE is_test = false OR is_test IS NULL)
),
churned_subs AS (
  SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.ended_at, s.mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s, bounds b
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= b.q_start AND s.ended_at < b.q_end
),
true_churn_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM churned_subs c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fct_subscriptions n
    WHERE n.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND n.status = 'active'
      AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (n.started_at - c.ended_at))) <= 86400
  )
    AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customers WHERE is_test = false OR is_test IS NULL)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT q_start FROM bounds) AS quarter_start,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_at_start) AS customers_at_start,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers) AS churned_customers,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers) AS DOUBLE)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_at_start), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM bounds;

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
active_subs AS (
  -- subscription-grain: cancelled rows that are NOT downgrades (no follow-on sub starting within 1 day with lower MRR)
  SELECT s.*
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
true_churn AS (
  SELECT s.customer_id, s.ended_at
  FROM active_subs s
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM active_subs n
      WHERE n.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND n.status = 'active'
        AND n.started_at >= s.ended_at
        AND n.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
        AND n.mrr < s.mrr
    )
),
at_risk AS (
  -- customers with an active subscription at the start of the quarter
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id, q.current_q_start, q.prev_q_start, q.current_q_end, q.prev_q_end
  FROM active_subs s
  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.current_q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.current_q_start)
),
at_risk_prev AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM active_subs s
  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.prev_q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.prev_q_start)
),
current_q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM at_risk) AS denom,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id)
     FROM true_churn tc, quarters q
     WHERE tc.ended_at >= q.current_q_start AND tc.ended_at < q.current_q_end
       AND tc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM at_risk)) AS numer
),
prev_q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM at_risk_prev) AS denom,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id)
     FROM true_churn tc, quarters q
     WHERE tc.ended_at >= q.prev_q_start AND tc.ended_at < q.prev_q_end
       AND tc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM at_risk_prev)) AS numer
)
SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period, numer AS churned_customers, denom AS at_risk_customers,
       CASE WHEN denom = 0 THEN NULL ELSE numer * 1.0 / denom END AS churn_rate
FROM current_q
UNION ALL
SELECT 'previous_quarter', numer, denom,
       CASE WHEN denom = 0 THEN NULL ELSE numer * 1.0 / denom END
FROM prev_q;

WITH latest_month AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS month_start,
         date_trunc('month', current_date) AS month_end
)
SELECT lm.month_start AS month,
       SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_usd
FROM fct_subscriptions s
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
CROSS JOIN latest_month lm
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND s.status IN ('active','paused')
  AND s.mrr > 0
  AND s.started_at < lm.month_end
  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= lm.month_end)
GROUP BY lm.month_start;

WITH arr_at AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2026-01-01' AS as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'active'
                        AND s.started_at <= DATE '2026-01-01'
                        AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
                      THEN s.mrr END), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'active'
                        AND s.started_at <= CURRENT_DATE
                        AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > CURRENT_DATE)
                      THEN s.mrr END), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_start_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) AS arr_today,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_ytd_growth
FROM arr_at;

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q,
         date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q
),
agg AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('quarter', ended_at) AS quarter_start,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN mrr END) AS cancelled_mrr,
         SUM(mrr) AS all_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions
  WHERE date_trunc('quarter', ended_at) IN (SELECT current_q FROM quarters UNION ALL SELECT prev_q FROM quarters)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT quarter_start,
       cancelled_mrr * 1.0 / NULLIF(all_mrr, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM agg
ORDER BY quarter_start

WITH starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::float
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.status = 'active'
            AND s.mrr > 0
            AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0
        END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.status = 'active'
            AND s.mrr > 0
            AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0
        END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(e.arr_end)::float / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS net_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

model_sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end, 'current_quarter' AS label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2025-10-01', DATE '2025-12-31', 'previous_quarter'
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT p.label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND s.started_at < p.period_start
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT p.label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
   AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
   AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  sc.label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cp.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END)::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc
LEFT JOIN churned_in_period cp
  ON cp.label = sc.label AND cp.customer_id = sc.customer_id
GROUP BY sc.label
ORDER BY sc.label;

)

FROM opp_outcomes

WITH customer_lifecycle AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    signup_date AS start_date,
    CAST(churned_at AS DATE) AS churn_date
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND signup_date IS NOT NULL
), monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', start_date) AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(*) AS customers_started,
    COUNT(churn_date) AS customers_churned
  FROM customer_lifecycle
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(customers_churned)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(customers_started), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM monthly_counts;

model_sql:
WITH arr_points AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2025-12-31' AS as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59')
    AND lower(coalesce(status, '')) IN ('active', 'trialing')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    DATE '2026-12-31' AS as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-12-31 23:59:59'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-12-31 23:59:59')
    AND lower(coalesce(status, '')) IN ('active', 'trialing')
), arr_growth AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) AS starting_arr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-12-31' THEN arr END) AS ending_arr
  FROM arr_points
)
SELECT
  starting_arr,
  ending_arr,
  ending_arr - starting_arr AS arr_growth_ytd,
  CASE
    WHEN starting_arr = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (ending_arr - starting_arr) / starting_arr
  END AS arr_growth_ytd_pct
FROM arr_growth;

      AND ended_at IS NOT NULL

            SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', d) AS month_start

WITH customer_churn AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    signup_date,
    churned_at,
    is_test
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), subscription_churn AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_started_at,
    MAX(ended_at) AS last_ended_at,
    BOOL_OR(status = 'active' AND ended_at IS NULL) AS has_active_subscription,
    COUNT(*) AS subscription_rows
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  GROUP BY 1
), comparison AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.signup_date,
    c.churned_at,
    s.first_started_at,
    s.last_ended_at,
    s.has_active_subscription,
    s.subscription_rows,
    CASE
      WHEN c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.has_active_subscription OR s.last_ended_at IS NULL) THEN 'customer_marked_churned_but_subscription_still_active_or_open'
      WHEN c.churned_at IS NULL AND s.last_ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(s.has_active_subscription, FALSE) THEN 'subscription_ended_but_customer_not_marked_churned'
      WHEN c.signup_date IS NOT NULL AND s.first_started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signup_date > CAST(s.first_started_at AS DATE) THEN 'customer_signup_after_subscription_start'
      WHEN c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_ended_at IS NOT NULL AND c.churned_at < s.last_ended_at THEN 'customer_churn_before_subscription_end'
      WHEN s.subscription_rows > 1 THEN 'multiple_subscriptions_per_customer_can_distort_customer_level_churn'
      WHEN c.churned_at IS NOT NULL AND s.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'customer_level_churn_without_subscription_record'
      ELSE 'appears_consistent'
    END AS issue
  FROM customer_churn c
  LEFT JOIN subscription_churn s
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
)
SELECT
  issue,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_customers
FROM comparison
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY customers DESC, issue;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
),
customer_quarters AS (
    SELECT 'current' AS quarter_label, b.current_q_start AS quarter_start, b.next_q_start AS quarter_end, c.customer_id, c.signup_date, c.churned_at, c.is_test
    FROM dim_customers c
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'previous' AS quarter_label, b.prev_q_start AS quarter_start, b.current_q_start AS quarter_end, c.customer_id, c.signup_date, c.churned_at, c.is_test
    FROM dim_customers c
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        quarter_label,
        quarter_start,
        quarter_end,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
              AND signup_date < quarter_start
        ) AS customers_at_start,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
              AND churned_at >= quarter_start
              AND churned_at < quarter_end
        ) AS churned_customers
    FROM customer_quarters
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT
    quarter_label,
    quarter_start,
    quarter_end,
    customers_at_start,
    churned_customers,
    CASE

    FROM month_arr
)

WITH q_bounds AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
start_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers_at_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.q_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
)
SELECT q.q_start AS quarter_start,
       q.q_end AS quarter_end,
       sc.customers_at_start,
       tc.churned_customers,
       CASE
           WHEN sc.customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE CAST(tc.churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / sc.customers_at_start
       END AS churn_rate
FROM q_bounds q
CROSS JOIN start_customers sc
CROSS JOIN true_churns tc;

    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < q.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
),
true_churn_flags AS (
  SELECT
    ss.sub_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.status = 'cancelled'
       AND ss.ended_at >= q.q_start
       AND ss.ended_at < q.q_end
       AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM fct_subscriptions nx
         WHERE nx.customer_id = ss.customer_id
           AND nx.status = 'active'
           AND nx.started_at >= ss.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
           AND nx.started_at <= ss.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
       )
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_true_churn_in_q1
  FROM start_subs ss
  CROSS JOIN q
)

    2
  ) AS gross_revenue_retention_pct
FROM start_subs s

WITH normalized_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN timezone('UTC', timezone('America/Los_Angeles', "timestamp"))
      ELSE "timestamp"
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    properties_jsonb
  FROM fct_events
), fiscal_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2025-04-01' AS fiscal_year_start,
    DATE '2025-07-01' AS q2_start
), opps_before_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      customer_id,
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.customer_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.customerId')
    ) AS customer_key,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id,
    event_type
  FROM normalized_events, fiscal_bounds
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
    AND event_ts_utc < q2_start
), fy26_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_key
  FROM opps_before_q2, fiscal_bounds
  WHERE customer_key IS NOT NULL

  SELECT DISTINCT customer_key

  WHERE customer_key IS NOT NULL

)

  COUNT(*) AS accounts_with_any_pipeline_activity_in_fy26_to_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM covered_accounts) AS accounts_with_identifiable_opportunity_pipeline,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM covered_accounts) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pipeline_coverage_pct
FROM fy26_accounts;

FROM (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01') feb
CROSS JOIN (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01') mar;

WITH customer_level_v1 AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', churned_at) AS churn_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS churned_customers_v1
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE churned_at IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
),
subscription_cancellations AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status,
        LEAD(s.mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
true_customer_churn AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ended_at) AS churn_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS churned_customers_true
    FROM subscription_cancellations
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
      AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (
          next_status = 'active'
          AND next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(DATEDIFF('day', ended_at, next_started_at)) <= 1
          AND (next_mrr <= mrr OR next_mrr IS NOT NULL)
      )
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(v1.churn_month, t.churn_month) AS month,
    COALESCE(v1.churned_customers_v1, 0) AS v1_churned_customers,
    COALESCE(t.churned_customers_true, 0) AS corrected_churned_customers,
    COALESCE(v1.churned_customers_v1, 0) - COALESCE(t.churned_customers_true, 0) AS overcount_from_v1,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(v1.churned_customers_v1, 0) > COALESCE(t.churned_customers_true, 0)
            THEN 'v1 overcounted churn by using dim_customers.churned_at at customer grain and missing downgrade-cancellations/re-subscriptions'
        WHEN COALESCE(v1.churned_customers_v1, 0) < COALESCE(t.churned_customers_true, 0)
            THEN 'v1 undercounted churn because dim_customers.churned_at did not capture all subscription-level cancellations'
        ELSE 'v1 matched corrected churn for this month'
    END AS diagnosis
FROM customer_level_v1 v1
FULL OUTER JOIN true_customer_churn t
    ON v1.churn_month = t.churn_month
ORDER BY 1;

    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), true_churn_events AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ended_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', ended_at) AS churn_quarter
    FROM subscription_transitions
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
      AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (
          next_status = 'active'
          AND next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND next_started_at <= ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
), quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_quarter_start
), quarters AS (
    SELECT current_quarter_start AS quarter_start, 'current_quarter' AS quarter_label FROM quarter_bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT current_quarter_start - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS quarter_start, 'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label FROM quarter_bounds
), quarter_starts AS (
    SELECT
        q.quarter_label,
        q.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS starting_customers
    FROM quarters q
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.started_at < q.quarter_start
     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), quarter_churns AS (
    SELECT
        q.quarter_label,
        q.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarters q
    LEFT JOIN true_churn_events t
      ON t.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
     AND t.ended_at < q.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    qs.quarter_label,
    qs.quarter_start,
    COALESCE(qc.churned_customers, 0) AS churned_customers,
    qs.starting_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN qs.starting_customers = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(qc.churned_customers, 0)::DOUBLE / qs.starting_customers
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_starts qs
LEFT JOIN quarter_churns qc
  ON qc.quarter_label = qs.quarter_label
 AND qc.quarter_start = qs.quarter_start
ORDER BY qs.quarter_start DESC;

), active_subs AS (
    SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN month_end m
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.started_at <= m.snapshot_ts
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > m.snapshot_ts)
      AND s.mrr >= 0
), snapshot_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS mrr_value

WITH opp_outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" + INTERVAL 8 HOUR
      ELSE "timestamp"
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    event_type,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id' AS VARCHAR),
      CAST(properties_jsonb->>'oppId' AS VARCHAR)
    ) AS opp_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
), deduped_outcomes AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY opp_id
        ORDER BY event_ts_utc DESC, event_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opp_outcomes
    WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
      AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS win_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_opportunities,
  COUNT(*) AS closed_opportunities
FROM deduped_outcomes;

  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS month,
    SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND paid_at >= DATE '2026-02-01'
    AND paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
selected_months AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM monthly_revenue
  WHERE month IN (DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-03-01')
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS revenue_feb_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END) AS revenue_mar_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS mom_change,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) IS NULL
      OR MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (
      MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END)
    ) / MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END)
  END AS mom_change_pct
FROM selected_months;

    date_trunc('month', started_at) AS month_start,

  GROUP BY 1
),
ytd AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start_of_ytd,

  FROM monthly_arr
)
SELECT
  arr_current_month_2026 - arr_start_of_ytd AS arr_growth_ytd_2026
FROM ytd;

model_sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT
    period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT
    period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::FLOAT / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-31 23:59:59+00' AS period_end
),
open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') AS opp_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'deal_value', e.properties_jsonb->>'dealValue') AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e.timezone, 'UTC'), e.timestamp)) < p.period_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_events e2
      WHERE COALESCE(e2.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e2.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') = COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
        AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e2.timezone, 'UTC'), e2.timestamp)) < p.period_end
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps;

WITH revenue_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) AS month_start,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
), feb AS (
  SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_month WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-02-01'

  mar.revenue - feb.revenue AS mom_change,
  (mar.revenue - feb.revenue) / NULLIF(feb.revenue, 0) AS mom_change_pct
FROM mar, feb;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id)
     FROM starting_cohort sc
     WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period)) AS churned_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort) AS starting_customers
)
SELECT churned_customers::DOUBLE / NULLIF(starting_customers, 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM counts;

model_sql:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2025-12-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT q.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM quarters q
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.signup_date < q.period_start
    AND s.started_at < q.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > q.period_start)
  GROUP BY q.period_label, c.customer_id
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT q.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM quarters q
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  WHERE c.churned_at >= q.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < q.period_end
  GROUP BY q.period_label, c.customer_id
),
cohort_counts AS (
  SELECT period_label, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count
  FROM starting_cohort
  GROUP BY period_label
),
churn_counts AS (
  SELECT sc.period_label, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS churned_customer_count
  FROM starting_cohort sc
  JOIN churned_in_period cp
    ON sc.period_label = cp.period_label
   AND sc.customer_id = cp.customer_id
  GROUP BY sc.period_label
)
SELECT
  q.period_label,
  COALESCE(cc2.churned_customer_count, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(cc.starting_cohort_count, 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM quarters q
LEFT JOIN cohort_counts cc ON q.period_label = cc.period_label
LEFT JOIN churn_counts cc2 ON q.period_label = cc2.period_label
ORDER BY CASE q.period_label WHEN 'previous_quarter' THEN 1 WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', COALESCE(s.started_at, c.signup_date, c.joined_dt)) AS cohort_quarter,
        c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churns AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.churned_at) AS churn_quarter,
        c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
quarterly_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ch.customer_id) AS churned_count
    FROM quarterly_cohorts qc
    LEFT JOIN churns ch ON qc.customer_id = ch.customer_id
                        AND qc.cohort_quarter = ch.churn_quarter
    GROUP BY qc.cohort_quarter
)
SELECT
    cohort_quarter,
    ROUND(CAST(churned_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(cohort_size, 0), 4) AS churn_rate
FROM quarterly_metrics
WHERE cohort_quarter IN (
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE),
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')
)
ORDER BY cohort_quarter DESC

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

totals AS (

)

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT
  won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes
